subject: Integration: co-ship telemetry & rebrand workflow for Helio embed
messages:
From: Miguel Santos <m.santos@heliosys.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: partners@heliosys.com
Date: 2027-06-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Partner integration inquiry — white-label embed

Hi Jasmine,

Quick intro — I lead partnerships at Helio Systems. We’re building a vertical analytics product and want to embed a rebranded LLM assistant that looks native inside our UI (white-label). Requirements in short:

- Co-branded UI with Helio copy/skins, but Redwood model served in the background
- Telemetry hooks for usage metrics and token-level cost breakdown sent to both parties
- SSO via SAML + optional SCIM provisioning
- Clear retention and exportability for audit purposes

Can Redwood support a partner-embedded runtime (private or dedicated) with those telemetry and rebrand controls? If so, can you share a rough integration plan and any standard MOU or commercial guardrails for distribution/resale?

Attachments: none

Thanks,
Miguel
Miguel Santos
Head of Partnerships, Helio Systems
partners@heliosys.com

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Miguel Santos <m.santos@heliosys.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-13T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner integration inquiry — white-label embed

Miguel — thanks for the clear summary. Helio’s use case maps well to our "partner-embed" flow. High-level answers and next steps below. I’ve attached an initial scope doc (IntegrationScope_v1.pdf).

Short answers:
- Yes — supported via Redwood Private (VPC) or Dedicated with partner-branding controls and a rebrand manifest we provide.
- Telemetry: we can stream anonymized usage metrics to a partner telemetry endpoint + provide monthly token/cost CSVs. We can also set up a webhook for event-level metrics if you need near-real-time.
- SSO/SCIM: SAML + SCIM provisioning supported in Private and Dedicated; for hosted APIs we offer SSO at the console level and can gate admin flows.
- Retention/export: configurable retention window (30/90/365 days) and downloadable audit exports for compliance.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Tech discovery call (30–45m) — define sequence lengths, expected concurrency, and whether private runtime is required for data residency.
2) Telemetry spec — we’ll propose field-level schema and retention model.
3) Commercial/ops — MOU draft and commercial model (rev-share vs. resale).

I’m copying Laura (Commercial) to start MOU/commercial and Markus (Infra) for a short tech feasibility read. If that works, how does Tue 6/15 10am PT look for a discovery call?

[attachment: IntegrationScope_v1.pdf (PDF, 95KB)]

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Partner Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Miguel Santos <m.santos@heliosys.com>
Date: 2027-06-15T08:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration: co-ship telemetry & rebrand workflow for Helio embed

Looping in a few ops/partner items and flagging what I will own:

- Commercial model: Laura -> will lead MOU draft. Two viable paths: a) reseller (Helio buys capacity from Redwood + resells), b) revenue share (joint billing). Need expected ARR and go-to-market lift to pick.
- Telemetry SLA: we need to confirm retention window and PII/PIA constraints — Markus, can you confirm what fields we can stream without increasing PII risk?
- Branding/governance: Vanessa, can you outline the branding manifest and what marketing/usage claims are allowed in co-branded assets?

Action items:
- Markus: quick feasibility note on telemetry schema (due 6/17 EOD) — include estimated extra infra cost for 7-day vs 90-day retention.
- Vanessa: draft partner branding do/don’t list (due 6/18).
- Jasmine: lock discovery call (confirmed for Tue 6/15 10am PT).

I attached a template TelemetryRetention_SLA.xlsx that Markus and I can use to capture options.

[attachment: TelemetryRetention_SLA.xlsx (XLSX, 22KB)]

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Miguel Santos <m.santos@heliosys.com>

Date: 2027-06-18T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration: co-ship telemetry & rebrand workflow for Helio embed

Thanks everyone — great discovery earlier today. Quick confirmations and asks: 

- Helio prefers a Dedicated deployment in our AWS account (we’ll provide VPC peering).
- Telemetry: 30-day rolling retention is acceptable for now, but we need export hooks for audits. Please confirm filenames and schema.
- Commercial: we’re inclined toward a reseller model to keep pricing simpler for our customers. Can Laura send a short MOU for review?
- Legal/compliance: we’ll need a simple Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and the SOC2 attestation copy.

I’ve started a DocuSign envelope for a short MOU to get the ball rolling (link below). Leaving the final terms to your team but wanted to speed up the commercial cadence.
